html.p: What it shows: Accounts with administrative privileges in Active Directory.

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | where(primaryGroupID=512 OR primaryGroupID=518 OR primaryGroupID=519 OR match(memberOf, "CN=Domain Admins") OR match(memberOf, "CN=Schema Admins") OR match(memberOf, "CN=Enterprise Admins")) | table displayName,primaryGroupID,memberOf,pwdLastSet,userAccountControl

html.p: What it shows: Non Machine Accounts with Service Principal Names (SPNs) set - making them vulnerable to Kerberoasting attacks.

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | where(isnotnull(servicePrincipalName)) | eval hasdisabled=if(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE") >= 0,1,0) | where hasdisabled = 0 | where isnull(dNSHostName) | table cn,userAccountControl,servicePrincipalName

html.p: What it shows: Accounts that haven't logged in for over 90 days.

panel.title: Inactive and Orphaned Accounts (User Accounts Only)

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | eval lastLogon_epoch=strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N%Z") | eval days_since_login = floor((now()-lastLogon_epoch)/86400) | where days_since_login > 90 | eval hasdisabled=if(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE") >= 0,1,0) | where hasdisabled = 0 | eval notworkstation=if(mvfind(userAccountControl,"WORKSTATION_TRUST_ACCOUNT") >=0,1,0) | where notworkstation = 0 | table displayName,sAMAccountName,days_since_login,lastLogonTimestamp,userAccountControl | sort - days_since_login

html.p: What it shows: Accounts with dangerous User Account Control (UAC) flags - "Password Never Expires" or "Password Not Required".

search.query: | inputlookup all-dc-users-comp-selectedattributes.csv | where (mvfind(userAccountControl,"PASSWD_NOTREQD") >= 0 OR mvfind(userAccountControl,"DONT_EXPIRE_PASSWD") >= 0) | eval hasdisabled=if(mvfind(userAccountControl,"ACCOUNTDISABLE") >= 0,1,0) | where hasdisabled = 0 | eval notworkstation=if(mvfind(userAccountControl,"WORKSTATION_TRUST_ACCOUNT") >=0,1,0) | where notworkstation = 0 | eval lastLogon_epoch=strptime(lastLogonTimestamp,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N%Z") | eval days_since_login = floor((now()-lastLogon_epoch)/86400) | table displayName,sAMAccountName,days_since_login,lastLogonTimestamp,userAccountControl
